verdict.rationale: Kimi's own help center lists 'memory' (记忆) among its general features alongside search, scheduled tasks and skills, so a first-party memory capability exists. The evidence is only a single index-line mention, with no detail on how memory persists across chats or is applied in new conversations. The million-token context window is in-session context, not cross-chat memory, and earns no credit here. Missing for 10: documentation of cross-conversation recall and application, user controls for viewing/editing/deleting memories, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
